exceptions.rationale: Potential denial of service through glob pattern amplification (globparts). minimatch is installed only through the lint toolchain (eslint 9 via @eslint/config-array, typescript-eslint via @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, eslint-config-next, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, @eslint-community/eslint-plugin-eslint-comments), all dev dependencies, and never runs in the deployed application; the only patterns it receives come from the repository configuration. Only minimatch 11.0.1 and later fix it, a major version these packages do not accept: eslint 9 calls the 3.x API. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-31 for 30 days; an agent may renew it for 30 days after a re-review while every path stays in the lint toolchain (a path into the deployed application needs the owner). Remove it as soon as eslint and typescript-eslint accept a fixed minimatch.
evidence: bun pm why minimatch on 2026-10-31: every path ends in a dev dependency (eslint-config-next 16.3.6, typescript-eslint 8.47.0, @typescript-eslint/parser 8.47.0, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y 6.10.2, @eslint-community/eslint-plugin-eslint-comments ^4.8.1, eslint ^9).
npm registry on 2026-10-31: minimatch 11.0.3 is the latest; @eslint/config-array 0.21.1 requires ^3.1.2 and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree 8.47.0 requires ^9.0.4.
